Enum Class ChannelType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ChannelType>
com.codedstreams.finconnectpro.sdk.domain.enums.ChannelType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ChannelType>, Constable
public enum ChannelType extends Enum<ChannelType>
Enumeration of financial channel types.

Defines the different types of financial channels and networks that the SDK can connect to.
